summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to elevate the Freelancer & Solo Practitioner category (freelance_solo / Category 16) to 100% production-ready quality. Covers dynamic calculation of all dashboard metrics (invoiced pipeline, effective hourly rate, true deliverable overrun), full CRUD support (delete clients with confirmation, edit/delete deliverables and projects, delete time logs, void/delete invoices, delete proposals), zero-data empty states with intuitive onboarding call-to-actions, dynamic branding and account holder metadata in printable invoices, and automatic project completion transitions.
